objections.claim: The pinned worked example does not exercise the rule's defining edge — consecutive non-alphanumeric collapse: no example demonstrates that a multi-character punctuation run collapses to a single hyphen, the transformation an LLM is most likely to get wrong.
objections.evidence: Spec §4 Slug discipline — the worked example and the FUNCTION headingSlug pseudocode; the refute-<lens>.md prompts each cite only this one example.
objections.predicted_consequence: An LLM refuter meeting a heading with consecutive punctuation emits phase-2--revised instead of phase-2-revised; the consumer string match fails and the objection falls to orchestrator:undefended — the exact zero-match path this ticket exists to reduce.

objections.claim: Empty-string anchor is named as an edge case but absent from the fixture matrix: no fixture, scenario, or DONE assertion exercises an empty-string spec_anchor through the validator or aggregate.mjs.
objections.evidence: §4 Edge cases vs §4 Back-compat and fixtures and the §8 DONE items.
objections.predicted_consequence: A build that special-cases empty strings would pass every named fixture yet violate the spec's stated edge-case behaviour; detectable only by a reviewer re-reading the edge-case list, not by any green gate.
